source_review.notes: Checked current NASA Configuration Management, Interface Management, and Technical Data Management guidance; NASA-STD-0005; NASA-HDBK-1004; NPR 7123.1B Change 4; current official NIST SP 800-128 update 1, SP 800-171 revision 3, and CSRC configuration-baseline glossary representations; and official ISO metadata for ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023. NASA and NIST resources returned HTTP 200. ISO returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client, but the current official web representation had already been inspected through the web retrieval path. The chapter labels NASA baseline names as organizational practice and requires local terminology rather than asserting a universal lifecycle taxonomy.

evidence: Reviewed baseline tuples, controlled item/version sets, relations, applicability, provenance, time, coherence predicates, documented/observed sets, Jaccard comparison, membership functions, baseline deltas, attribute mismatch, and instance/time-specific change state.
Confirmed optional, repeated, redundant, variant, site, serial, lot, and lifecycle usages are not collapsed into a simplistic one-definition/one-version model.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Set and digest mechanisms are explicitly bounded as discrepancy and identity aids rather than semantic or physical conformance proofs.

evidence: Executed configuration-item-record-check and reproduced six items, one well-formed declared record, each exact missing field, and the expected unresolved set.
Recomputed Example 5 as one documented-but-missing item, two observed-but-unrecorded items, union size ten, and Jaccard 7/10 = 0.70.

Recomputed Answer 1 as two documented-only, three observed-only, union size fifteen, and Jaccard 10/15 = 2/3; recomputed Answer 2 as 40 active, 5 verified-not-active, 10 failed, 5 awaiting verification, and 40 not implemented.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All displayed arithmetic agrees with independent recomputation. Counts do not encode configuration consequence or evidence adequacy.

evidence: Confirmed documented/observed discrepancies derive from set difference and item-label similarity is supplemented by attribute/relationship equivalence.
Confirmed added, removed, and changed sets require stable identity and normalized applicability.
Confirmed change state depends on instance and time, preserving authorization, implementation, verification, incorporation, failure, rollback, and supersession as distinct states.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter makes no claim that reference closure or Jaccard equality establishes baseline coherence, product correctness, or actual conformity.

evidence: Challenged mutable latest tags, individually current but incompatible documents, supplier option/version mismatch, serial/lot effectivity, approved-but-not-deployed changes, unrecorded drift, emergency redlines, data/model gaps, changing external services, incomplete rollback, and retirement state.

Reviewed functional, allocated, product, as-designed, as-built, as-tested, as-deployed, as-maintained, variant, site, supplier, software/build, data/model, procedure, facility, people, security, maintenance, and retirement boundaries.
Reviewed all ten examples and five answers for identity, applicability, coherence, change state, audit evidence, recovery, privacy, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Actual high-consequence baselines still require applicable domain, configuration, quality, safety, security, supplier, regulatory, operational, maintenance, data/privacy, and affected-stakeholder review.

evidence: Traced baseline and CI identity, immutable history, coherence, lifecycle-view distinction, change-state distinction, impact/effectivity, bilateral interface control, external dependency, status accounting, audit, emergency change, record protection, and evidence-applicability invariants throughout the chapter.
Confirmed snapshot, release, manifest, inventory, BOM/product structure, repository commit, cryptographic digest, and baseline remain distinct artifacts and claims.
Confirmed actual-product reconciliation and historical reconstruction are required rather than inferred from repository state.
invariant_checking.notes: A baseline is consistently treated as an authorized coherent change reference, not a frozen folder or list of current files.

proof_review.notes: The chapter presents set relations and integrity obligations but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Reviewed current, approved, implemented, verified, released, installed, activated, retired, coherent, compatible, reproducible, audited, signed, and observed language for explicit state and evidence scope.
artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-039/report.json records exact local execution evidence for the CI declaration checker.

Repository, signature/digest, build, supplier, qualification, calibration, field observation, audit, test, deployment, maintenance, and rollback evidence is bounded by identity, provenance, configuration, applicability, method, result, anomalies, and limitations.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No external review is claimed. Manifests, signatures, digests, clean diffs, or automated inventory are never presented as universal proof of semantic, physical, safety, security, or operational correctness.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked configuration, CI, baseline/baseline configuration, identification, effectivity, change control, status accounting, functional/allocated/product/deployed baselines, as-designed/built/tested/deployed/maintained views, FCA/PCA, snapshot, release, inventory, and product structure. Local taxonomy and lifecycle applicability remain explicit.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked coherent controller manifests, conflicting voltage documents, serial/lot effectivity, partial fleet implementation, observed drift, emergency field redline, data/model reproduction, mutable external service, incomplete rollback, retirement, container deployment, power-module effectivity, and medication-delivery configuration. Each case ties controlled identity to change, evidence, field state, recovery, and lifecycle ownership.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from terminology and CI selection through baseline manifest/reference closure/coherence, applicability/provenance, controlled change/effectivity/status, realized-state reconciliation, software/data/supplier/procedure/facility governance, variants/emergency changes/audits, rollback, and retirement. Ten examples and five complete answers require set arithmetic, state accounting, effectivity logic, deployment critique, and sociotechnical baseline design.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, practitioner, configuration-management, architecture, mechanical, electrical, thermal, fluid, software, data, control, safety, security, privacy, accessibility, human-factors, supplier, manufacturing, quality, facilities, logistics, operations, maintenance, integration, verification, validation, regulatory, clinical, or affected-stakeholder review is claimed.
